text.p: SYDNEY, Aug 14 (Reuuer) - Leighton Holdings Ltd said on Thursday that it had appointed Paul Jackson and Associates for a strategic review of the construction company and also to review options for the company's large cash holdings.
"I don't feel pressured about returning funds to shareholders," managing director Wal King told reporters.
King said there would be no quick decisions made on any uses for the cash, including acquisitions.
The debt-free company, which has operations based in Australia and Southeast Asia, has available cash of A$422.88 million. It is about 45 percent owned by Hochtief AG.
King said the company was interested in expanding into the South American mining industry.
The company earlier announced a 32 percent rise in net profit before abnormal items to A$86.24 million in 1996/97 (July/June) from A$65.27 million.
It increased the total dividend payout to 32 cents a share from 15 cents, representing a payment of A$83.02 million for the latest 12 months.
Leighton announced a special interim dividend of 10 cents per share on top of the final dividend of 13 cents.
"I don't feel pressured in what we are going to do with the cash," King said.
"We are giviing a good rate of return and we expect to continue that rate of return."
